note: One place that says what each data series is, how far it goes, and whether it may be treated as current. Pages, docs and releases should agree with this file; test/series_status.test.js checks that every path exists and the README table lists every series. Change a status here only with the evidence in docs/DATA_CHANGELOG.md or docs/AGENT_CHANGELOG.md.

status_values.production: on the dashboard or map, validated against its source, with a release manifest
status_values.staged: collected and checked, kept out of the dashboard on purpose
status_values.provisional: partial-period or partly verified; never to be compared with a full year
status_values.not_published: the official release does not exist yet
status_values.not_implemented: an official source is archived but no usable layer has been built
status_values.retained_legacy_year: an older survey or geography kept for reference, not refreshed

series.name: NCRB district crime (IPC/BNS, SLL, crimes against women)
series.note: 2016 to 2024 each have a release manifest. Null means not reported, not zero.

series.name: Delhi Traffic Police citywide road trend
series.note: 2011-2024 total crashes, fatal crashes and persons killed. Counts, not rates. Injury/category edition differences are excluded from the extension; victim-by-mode remains 2019-2024.

series.name: NCRB historical district crime counts, as printed
series.geography: original annual reporting districts (11 in 2011-2016, 14 in 2017-2018); no allocation to current districts
series.note: On historical_crime.html. Counts only, never trended across the 2013/2014 definition break or joined to modern districts, wards or infrastructure. Null means not reported, not zero. Offence definitions differ by year; see the manifest.

series.name: Historical police-district reference maps, 2011-2018
series.geography: 2014 station polygons regrouped by the Dec 2014 roster (2011-2016, inferred) and the Nov 2017 gazette schedule (2017-2018)
series.note: Schematic, not to scale. Shown on historical_crime.html under 'inferred' or 'derived' labels; not certified annual boundaries.

series.name: NCRB Crime in India 2025
series.note: The latest edition found is 2024 (published May 2026). No totalIPC2025 field is created.

series.name: Delhi Traffic Police crash-prone zones
series.geography: named locations (93 zones in 2024); 15 police districts
series.note: Counts are from the report. Map positions are landmark-centre estimates, roughly 250 m to 1 km off, not police geotags.

series.name: Delhi Traffic Police annual Road Crash Report 2025
series.note: No qualifying full-year 2025 report was found.

series.name: District iRAD road-accident reports
series.geography: revenue districts and police stations as printed; not mapped to the 15 police districts
series.note: A different series from the traffic police report. Periods, layouts and scope differ by report; see docs/IRAD_DISTRICT_REPORTS.md. Linked from the dashboard as a prototype page, not part of the maps.

series.name: iRAD reports for 2026
series.latest_reference_period: 2026-01 to 2026-08 (South East to July, North East to August, New Delhi to May)
series.geography: only the districts that publish 2026 reports
series.note: Partial year and partial district coverage. Never compare with a full year.

series.name: Delhi Police 2025 citywide counts as reported by two news outlets
series.geography: Delhi as a whole, 8 offences, no district split
series.note: Unverified: no police table found. Not comparable with the NCRB series.

series.name: OpenStreetMap infrastructure snapshots (overbridges, signals, crossings, hospitals, cameras, police, footways)
series.geography: points and ways, assigned to districts and wards
series.note: Mapped by volunteers; incomplete. Low coverage means unmapped, not absent.

series.name: Sidewalk, footway and crossing mapping around crash zones
series.geography: 250 m and 500 m around each 2024 crash zone
series.note: Measures how much is tagged on OpenStreetMap, not whether pavements exist.

series.name: Official liquor vend list
series.note: The list is incomplete and its snapshot date is unclear; do not label it a verified inventory for any year.

series.name: Delhi wards, legacy 290-ward geography
series.geography: 290 legacy wards (273 MCD, 9 NDMC, 8 Cantonment polygons)
series.note: Pre-2022 geography, kept as a finer grid for density aggregation; not an official or current boundary and not the current 250 wards. Every ward-level layer (land use, infrastructure, Master Plan comparison) uses it and is labelled legacy.

series.name: Delhi wards, current 250-ward geography (MCD delimitation 2022)
series.note: Official source is Geospatial Delhi Limited (GSDL). Its map is restricted (reproduction prohibited without written permission) and reconstruction is not viable: the linework forms 921 faces, not 250 wards. The notification is archived here. Next step: ask GSDL for the digital layer with written reuse terms; no request has been sent. Nothing should be traced or invented in the meantime.

series.name: Master Plan 2047 against 2021 satellite land cover
series.note: Prototype page. Satellite sees cover, not use; a gap is a lead, not a violation.

series.name: Staged iRAD 2025 release
series.latest_reference_period: 2025; coverage differs by reporting district and table
series.geography: reporting districts and station labels; not the 15 police districts
series.note: Authoritative staged release from derived iRAD tables; annual and monthly windows overlap. Not integrated into the dashboard.

series.name: Police station crosswalk using the 2026 Manual
series.geography: source reporting labels matched to current territorial station identities
series.note: Draft Manual evidence pending human verification; unresolved and specialised labels have no territorial assignment.
